schedule: After each25000 completed decisions, before next collection; append at most1 task/terrain. Stop after10 rounds, maximum50 new tasks. Never remove original or failed tasks.
parents: Original30 parents only; prefer recent normal-terminal frontier parents in each terrain when legal unused neighbors remain, otherwise original parents. No validation outcomes and no generated-parent drift.
mutations: Exactly one deck/multiplier/level changes; cap/sun/preplants/playthrough remain parent values. Deck presets and same-terrain training levels explicit; daylevel destinations are2/3/4, while originallevel1 parents remain. Adventure-II actual native full wave count is20 atlevel1; previous explanation based on first-playthrough4 waves was wrong, not a mutation implementation failure.
seeds: One dedicated disjoint64-seed block per round/terrain, reserved even if no candidate remains. Generator seed9031 shared across initialization configs; actual parent selection may differ with training history.
state: Complete checkpoint saves generated pool and round events together with PPO optimizer/RNG/curriculum. An interrupted collection regenerates the same next round from the last complete boundary. Pool JSON is a readable mirror, checkpoint is authoritative.
interpretation: Bounded curriculum heuristic, no guarantee of useful tasks, feasibility or learning gains. No retrospective threshold/validation/seed removal. This optional implementation does not change currently running fixed pools.
adoption: Brief deterministic continuation/history/seed checks plus native reset and actual model collector/PPO paths; no hours-long superiority test required before optional mainline integration.
auxiliary_prediction: Cancelled; no auxiliary heads, labels or losses.
